movie.title: Cottonmouth
movie.overview: When Ed Dantes is framed and condemned to the tortures of a territorial prison in the 1895, he must learn the ways of the outlaw to escape and exact his revenge.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: In 1895, a wrongfully imprisoned man learns the rugged rules of the outlaw world to break free from a brutal territorial prison and take revenge on those who betrayed him.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: When Ed Dantes is framed and sentenced to a harsh territorial prison in 1895, his life as an honest man comes to a sudden, devastating end. Stripped of his freedom and subjected to horrific abuse, he realizes that surviving requires adopting a far darker persona. By mastering the ruthless ways of the outlaw, Ed plots a daring escape to return to the frontier and unleash a cold, calculated campaign of vengeance against the enemies who set him up.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Set against the rugged frontier of 1895, Cottonmouth follows Ed Dantes, an innocent man whose life is shattered after being framed for a crime he did not commit. Condemned to an isolated territorial prison, Ed is thrust into an unforgiving world of sadistic guards, corrupt administration, and hardened criminals. As the physical and psychological tortures of the facility mount, Ed comes to accept that his former morality will only lead to his death. He turns to the prison's most dangerous inmates, adapting to the harsh culture of the West and learning the precise, lethal skills of an outlaw. Through months of disciplined preparation and dangerous alliances, Ed carefully orchestrates a high-stakes prison break. Once free, he emerges no longer as the victim, but as a ruthless gunslinger driven by a singular purpose. Traveling across the dust-choked territory, he systematically tracks down each co-conspirator responsible for his downfall. Ed's relentless quest for justice blurs the line between lawman and outlaw, testing whether vengeance can truly bring him peace.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Set in 1895, Cottonmouth is a gritty, high-stakes Western thriller that reimagines classic revenge lore against the backdrop of the American frontier. The story centers on Ed Dantes, a law-abiding man whose life is upended when a cruel conspiracy leads to his wrongful conviction and imprisonment in a brutal territorial penitentiary. Facing unthinkable hardship behind bars, Ed must discard his old morals and embrace the violent, pragmatic ethos of the outlaw to survive. Guided by hardened criminals within the walls, he undergoes a total transformation in mind and skill, preparing for a harrowing bid for freedom. Filled with intense action, psychological tension, and stark frontier drama, the narrative explores the heavy cost of retribution as Ed sets out to hunt down the men who stole his life.

story_structure.climax: Breaking free from the territorial prison, Ed confronts the corrupt figures responsible for his imprisonment, putting his new outlaw skills to the test.

story_structure.resolution: With his vengeance exacted, Ed must navigate the aftermath of his retribution and come to terms with the man he became to achieve it.

story_structure.risingAction: Ed carefully plans a dangerous escape while forging unlikely alliances and adopting the mindset of a hardened criminal to prepare for his ultimate mission.
